Open framework building

Total force on the whole structure

For open framework buildings (e.g. sign frames, lattice towers) the total force on the
whole structure can be determined from the sum of the force acting on the individual
members using the total pressure coefficient of the element member, provided that the
element members are separated wide apart. When the spacing of the elements is small,
the flow around the element members will interfere with each other, and the
interference is a function of the solidity ratio.

The general equation for the determination of total force on an open framework
building not significant in dynamic resonant response is:

_ Effective projected area of the open framework building
Area enclosed by the boundary of the frame normal to the wind direciton

The effective projected area of the open framework building is the aggregate projected
area of all members of the frame projected on a plane normal to the direction of the
wind front.

It is to be noted from Table D4 of the Code that the force coefficient has a value of 2.0
when the solidity ratio is 0.01. This value represents the force coefficient for long and
small cross-sectional size members separated wide apart. The force coefficient for a
frame of solidity ratio approaching 1.0 also has the value of 2.0. This represents the
